# CMind LMS

> CMind is a B2B multi-tenant School Learning Management System (LMS) built for educational institutions in the Arab world, with full Arabic RTL and English LTR support.

## What is CMind?

CMind (https://cmind.tech) is a cloud-based LMS platform that enables schools and educational organizations to manage courses, students, teachers, assignments, and performance tracking — all in one place.

## Key Features

- Multi-tenant architecture: each school gets its own isolated workspace
- Arabic RTL + English LTR full internationalization (i18n)
- Student points and rewards system
- Teacher rating system
- Real-time notifications via Socket.io
- Course management, assignment tracking, and grading tools
- Secure authentication with JWT (httpOnly cookies)
- File uploads via AWS S3
- Email notifications via Gmail
- Light and dark mode support

## Who is CMind for?

- K-12 schools and private educational centers
- Educational technology companies
- School administrators, teachers, and students

## Technology

CMind is built on a modern stack:
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zustand
- Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Socket.io
